title: Catching Thief With Wisdom
simplified_paragraphs: 一天晚上，一个农夫看见一个人拿着一大包东西向邻村跑去了。第二天，农夫发现原来是自己的棉花被偷了，于是他就去找聪明的弟弟麦克商量该怎么办。
麦克想了想，然后把邻村的人都邀请过来参加舞会。在舞会上，麦克对大家说："不好意思，昨天我哥哥的棉花被偷了，而今天小偷却自己来了。你们看，到现在他的脸上和头发上还沾着棉花呢！”
这样一说，有一个人脸上和头发上没有沾棉花，却紧张地反复摸着他的脸和头发。麦克走到那个人旁边说："小偷就是他！”就这样，偷棉花的人被抓住了。
traditional_paragraphs: 一天晚上，一個農夫看見一個人拿著一大包東西向鄰村跑去了。第二天，農夫發現原來是自己的棉花被偷了，於是他就去找聰明的弟弟麥克商量該怎麼辦。
麥克想了想，然後把鄰村的人都邀請過來參加舞會。在舞會上，麥克對大家說："不好意思，昨天我哥哥的棉花被偷了，而今天小偷卻自己來了。你們看，到現在他的臉上和頭髮上還沾著棉花呢！”
這樣一說，有一個人臉上和頭髮上沒有沾棉花，卻緊張地反覆摸著他的臉和頭髮。麥克走到那個人旁邊說："小偷就是他！”就這樣，偷棉花的人被抓住了。
pinyin_paragraphs: yī tiān wǎn shang， yī gè nóng fū kàn jiàn yī gè rén ná zhe yī dà bāo dōng xi xiàng lín cūn pǎo qù le。 dì èr tiān， nóng fū fā xiàn yuán lái shì zì jǐ de mián huā bèi tōu le， yú shì tā jiù qù zhǎo cōng míng de dì di Mài kè shāng liang gāi zěn me bàn。

Mài kè xiǎng le xiǎng， rán hòu bǎ lín cūn de rén dōu yāo qǐng guò lái cān jiā wǔ huì。 zài wǔ huì shàng， Mài kè duì dà jiā shuō：" bù hǎo yì si， zuó tiān wǒ gē ge de mián huā bèi tōu le， ér jīn tiān xiǎo tōu què zì jǐ lái le。 nǐ men kàn， dào xiàn zài tā de liǎn shàng hé tóu fa shàng hái zhān zhe mián huā ne！”

zhè yàng yī shuō， yǒu yī gè rén liǎn shàng hé tóu fa shàng méi yǒu zhān mián huā， què jǐn zhāng de fǎn fù mō zhe tā de liǎn hé tóu fa。 Mài kè zǒu dào nà gè rén páng biān shuō：" xiǎo tōu jiù shì tā！” jiù zhè yàng， tōu mián huā de rén bèi zhuā zhù le。
english_paragraphs: One evening, a farmer saw someone carrying a large bundle toward the neighboring village. The next day, he discovered that his cotton had been stolen, so he went to ask his clever younger brother, Mike, what to do.

Mike thought for a moment, then invited everyone from the neighboring village to a dance. At the dance, he said, “I’m sorry to bring this up, but my brother’s cotton was stolen yesterday, and the thief has come here today. Look—even now, there’s still cotton stuck to his face and hair!”
At that, one man who had no cotton on his face or hair nervously touched them again and again. Mike walked up to him and said, “He’s the thief!” And that was how the cotton thief was caught.
english_full:
One evening, a farmer saw someone carrying a large bundle toward the neighboring village. The next day, he discovered that his cotton had been stolen, so he went to ask his clever younger brother, Mike, what to do.

Mike thought for a moment, then invited everyone from the neighboring village to a dance. At the dance, he said, “I’m sorry to bring this up, but my brother’s cotton was stolen yesterday, and the thief has come here today. Look—even now, there’s still cotton stuck to his face and hair!”

At that, one man who had no cotton on his face or hair nervously touched them again and again. Mike walked up to him and said, “He’s the thief!” And that was how the cotton thief was caught.
